CustomField.formula: CASE( TEXT(sbaa__Status__c) , "Requested", IMAGE("/img/loading.gif", "Pending", 16, 16), "Approved", IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/confirm16.png", "Approved", 16, 16), "Rejected", IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/error16.png", "Rejected", 16, 16), "Recalled", IMAGE("/img/func_icons/util/ileUndo16.gif", "Recalled", 16, 16), "Revoked", IMAGE("/img/func_icons/remove12_on.gif", "Revoked", 16, 16), "" ) & " - " & TEXT(sbaa__Status__c)
CustomField.label: Status
